category_edits.rationale: L2-normalize the shared item embedding lookups for sequence inputs, positive and negative targets, and candidates. This removes item-norm variation while retaining tied embeddings, the input scaling, causal convolutions, dot-product scoring, loss, and optimizer. Padding remains exactly zero. The generated predictor imports this same model class, preserving training/inference consistency without checkpoint shape changes.

change_summary: Apply epsilon-safe L2 normalization to every item embedding lookup across all four category models, with exactly zero padding and consistent predictor behavior.
